controls.cache_policy: managed fresh load each period; same untimed25checkpreflight andOracle18 beforeSWE; APC recipe setting unchanged

limitations: two periods are bounded evidence, not broad benchmark generalization
SWE agent-stage duration includes tool/container activity, not pure GPUcompute

performance.aggregate: sum resolved across both periods divided by sum agent-stage duration_s, multiplied by3600
performance.failures: all attempts and elapsed retained, zero success for failed tasks; anyqualityfailure stops promotion qualification
performance.primary: officially resolved SWE tasks per hour of SWE agent-stage duration_s
performance.requirement: candidate/incumbent >=1.10 aggregate AND A1/B1 >=1.10 AND A2/B2 >=1.10

stop_policy: No unchanged quality-failure retries, no tuning betweenperiods. Restore/readmitexactr11 atclosure unlessallpromotiongatespass.
